title: Hybrid Attention from Scratch
blurb: Combine sliding-window attention, grouped-query attention and recurrent linear layers, and measure what each costs in cache memory.
intro: Long-context models increasingly mix layer types: a few full-attention layers for exact recall, and many cheaper layers whose memory does not grow with the sequence. The steps build a sliding-window mask with attention sinks, the cache budget of a mixed stack, grouped-query attention, linear attention as a running state, and the gated delta rule that overwrites that state along each key. The capstone runs a hybrid stack of sliding-window and delta-rule layers and returns the fixed-size states those layers cache.
